concepts.title: 和弦触点
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: an original app icon concept for Chordesk, a remote desktop app for a folding Duo phone. Its unique interaction is like holding a guitar chord: fingers on the back change the mode while the thumb controls the front. Design a premium restrained Liquid Glass icon, with translucent milky glass, quiet frosted depth, soft edge refraction, diffuse lighting, low saturation. Not associated with STLAND or any existing logo. NOT glossy candy, NO primary red/yellow/blue, NO shiny balls, NO metallic bevels, NO bright specular hotspots, NO lens flares, NO glowing neon. Strong legible silhouette even at small app-icon size. One icon, square 1024 canvas filled with a very pale mist-grey background, ample but not excessive breathing room. Center symbol occupies about two thirds of canvas. Flat front-facing composition, shallow material depth, no mockup, no outer squircle or border, no typography or lettering, no captions, no watermark. Concept A: a beautifully simplified chord fingering symbol. Exactly three parallel vertical rounded glass bars of equal length, softly tinted desaturated slate blue. Two understated flattened oval contact marks join adjacent bars at different heights, expressing coordinated simultaneous finger pressure. Contact marks must read as subtle frosted glass pads embedded in the structure, never spherical buttons. Clear graphic negative space, calm architectural rhythm, minimal recognisable line-and-contact geometry, no fret grid, no literal guitar, no hands. The design should feel like a new native productivity tool icon rather than a music player.

concepts.title: 弦与桌面
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset: an original app icon concept for Chordesk, a remote desktop app for a folding Duo phone. Fingers on the back hold combinations like guitar chords to change the front thumb's control mode. Premium restrained Liquid Glass visual language: thin translucent milky glass with soft optical edge refraction, subtle frosted body, diffuse lighting. Very low-saturation fog blue and smoke grey only. No STLAND influence. NO saturated colors, NO primary-color dots, NO candy buttons, NO glossy spheres, NO chrome, NO dramatic highlights, NO lens flare, NO neon. Crisp intentional bold silhouette readable at 32px, restrained and elegant rather than decorative. Single centered symbol about two thirds of a square 1024 canvas on a full-bleed pale neutral fog background. No outer icon mask, no outside border, no device mockup, no hand, no literal guitar, no words, no captions, no watermark. Concept C: a single frontal rounded-rectangle desktop monitor outline in softly tinted translucent slate glass, with a very short elegantly integrated central stand. Inside this frame, exactly THREE vertical parallel rounded strings run from near the top to near the bottom. A single short gently diagonal translucent bridge crosses the three strings, visually combining a guitar chord and a remote desktop. The strings and bridge are bold and sparse, not fine lines. The screen stays entirely empty and transparent except these three strings and bridge. The whole symbol is almost a flat monoline glyph with shallow glass depth. A practical distinctive productivity-app emblem: the monitor must read immediately, the chord is the second reading. Avoid realistic screen hardware, no shiny black display, no fretboard grid, no music notes, no cursor.
